sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-21 on akiendelllinux: cdfc928cc5ff's hollow (323 commons records, ~17 s per tester run, ~93 min) was killed by prove.sh's `timeout 1500` at 25 min. prove.sh's last line pipes the hollow through `tail -4`, so prove.sh exited with tail's 0 and printed nothing under '--- hollow'; the walk went on to a confirmed verdict, and only the PROVED gate's hollow_evidence_absent caught it.
